process_observations.observation: The repair needed no guesswork: the org's own deploy message named the exact missing field (Probability) and the exact required behavior (the message is 'Layout must contain an item for required layout field', which the skill's table maps to 'add a layoutItems entry, any behavior' - but gotchas.md #13's Case precedent, and the fact this is the platform-required case rather than a design choice, argues for writing Required directly rather than waiting for a second dry-run round to report 'Field:Probability must be Required'). Writing Required now is consistent with A25's own discovery procedure in deploy-order.md §3 item 2 and avoids a foreseeable second round trip.

No new component type was introduced by this repair (Probability is a layout item inside an existing Layout component, not a new metadata type), so package.xml needed no edit. The manifest still names exactly the two Layout members the files provide, in both directions.

The invocation asked for 'two INFO findings and exit 0' as the expected re-run result. The actual re-run is two findings and exit 0, but the severities are one REVIEW (the identical-Enterprise/Renewal-layout merge candidate, RTL-MERGE-01 - unaffected by this repair since both files still received the identical edit) and one INFO ('no Profile/PermissionSet in scope'), not two INFO. The checker itself has changed since the step's original 2026-09-15 run: that run's declared-test output carried exactly two INFO findings ('layout marks no field behavior=Required', once per layout) and no REVIEW or Profile/PermissionSet-scope finding at all - this build's copy of check_record_type_layouts.py has grown RTL-MERGE-01 and RTL-ASSIGN-01 since that run, independent of anything this step wrote. Adding Probability with behavior=Required did remove both original 'marks no field behavior=Required' INFOs, exactly as expected; what it could not do is make the now-different checker's remaining findings match a two-INFO description written against the old checker. Reported verbatim below rather than reworded to fit.

A25 is now partially discharged rather than closed: the org confirmed Probability is layout-required for Opportunity, but the dry run reports one missing field per run (gotchas.md #12), so a layout still short of a second or third required field would not have surfaced yet. deploy-order.md §6 says this explicitly and keeps §3 item 2's iterate-the-dry-run instruction standing rather than marking A25 resolved. A human reading only N3-F-02 and this repair could reasonably - and wrongly - conclude the Opportunity layout-required set is now fully known.

A parallel repair of M1-S01 is running concurrently per the invocation. This run touched only artefacts/M1-S02/, envelopes/M1-S02/ and this step's own plan.json status field; it did not read or write anything under artefacts/M1-S01/ beyond the read-only citation of M1-S01's deploy-order.md already on file from the prior run. decision_record.question: N3-F-02 fix: what behavior does the new Probability layoutItems entry carry?
decision_record.answer: Required, not Edit. The deploy message ('Layout must contain an item for required layout field: Probability') only strictly requires an entry with 'any behavior' per the skill's layout-required-fields table, but admin/record-types-and-page-layouts/references/gotchas.md #13 establishes that a field the platform requires on the layout is not the analyst's Edit/Required choice - it is a deploy precondition, exactly as Status is on Case. Writing Required now, on the strength of the org's own finding that Probability is platform-required here, avoids a foreseeable second dry-run round reporting 'Field:Probability must be Required'.
